## How a loan is described here
- FHFA: a jumbo loan is a mortgage with an origination balance above the conforming loan limit for the county and the number of units.
- 2026 county limits on the loan-limits page come from the FHFA news release of November 25, 2025 and the 2026 full county file.
- A cash-out refinance, as the CFPB describes it, replaces the existing mortgage with a larger mortgage and the borrower takes the difference in cash. A rate-and-term refinance replaces the mortgage without taking extra principal.
